source.title: Functional neurological restoration of amputated peripheral nerve using biohybrid regenerative bioelectronics

material: PEDOT:PSS microelectrode array on parylene C with fibrin hydrogel and iPSC-derived myocytes (biohybrid device)

formulation.evidence: Final concentrations are as follows: FG = 3.125, 6.25, 12.5, and 25 mg/ml; Th = 1 U/ml; and CaCl2 = 20 mM.

processing.evidence: The solution is spin-coated three times with soft bakes for 60 s at 120°C.
